latest.text: Thanks for the patience and the screenshots, they helped a lot. I think I found the cause: packages that Orbis Store downloads into /data/homebrew are saved with permissions that block sandboxed apps from reading them. That's why they show greyed out and the conversion stops with "Package not found", even though the file itself is fine. The next version opens up the file's permissions through the helper and retries automatically. I'm testing it on my console now and will post here when it's rel…
